entries.title: Numbers 36:1
segments: ¶Now the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the leaders, the chief fathers of the children of Israel.

entries.title: Numbers 36:2
segments: And they said: "The LORD commanded my lord [Moses] to give the land as an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel, and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.

entries.title: Numbers 36:3
segments: "Now if they are married to any of the sons of the [other] tribes of the children of Israel, then their inheritance will be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and it will be added to the inheritance of the tribe into which they marry; so it will be taken from the lot of our inheritance.

entries.title: Numbers 36:4
segments: "And when the Jubilee of the children of Israel comes, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe into which they marry; so their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers."

entries.title: Numbers 36:5
segments: ¶Then Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD, saying: "What the tribe of the sons of Joseph speaks is right.

entries.title: Numbers 36:6
segments: "This [is] what the LORD commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, 'Let them marry whom they think best, but they may marry only within the family of their father's tribe.'

entries.title: Numbers 36:7
segments: "So the inheritance of the children of Israel shall not change hands from tribe to tribe, for every one of the children of Israel shall keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

entries.title: Numbers 36:8
segments: "And every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be the wife of one of the family of her father's tribe, so that the children of Israel each may possess the inheritance of his fathers.

entries.title: Numbers 36:9
segments: "Thus no inheritance shall change hands from [one] tribe to another, but every tribe of the children of Israel shall keep its own inheritance."

entries.title: Numbers 36:10
segments: Just as the LORD commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad;

entries.title: Numbers 36:11
segments: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to the sons of their father's brothers.

entries.title: Numbers 36:12
segments: They were married into the families of the children of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of their father's family.

entries.title: Numbers 36:13
segments: These [are] the commandments and the judgments which the LORD commanded the children of Israel by the hand of Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan, [across from] Jericho.
